name: Lemon Chicken Orzo with Spinach and Peas

components.name: Chicken
steps: Mix diced chicken with olive oil and spices; brown in a deep pan until fully cooked, then reserve.

components.name: Lemon Orzo with Greens
steps: Soften onion in the second measured quantity of olive oil; add garlic for about 30 seconds.
Add dry orzo and stir one minute, then pour in 800 ml stock. Simmer, stirring regularly, for around 8 to 10 minutes until orzo is almost tender.
Lower heat and stir in 300 ml milk and 60 ml cream, warming gently without boiling hard.
Mix in lemon zest, juice, grated parmesan, spinach and frozen peas; stir until vegetables are heated through.
Fold in cooked chicken and any resting juices; distribute evenly into five containers.
When reheating, add a little measured water or milk to loosen thickened orzo, and heat thoroughly.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source 5 servings. Nutrition is creator-published and is for completed dish. Extra lemon zest measured here as 3g fixed app quantity.
Storing & reheating: Source says up to 4 days fridge and 3 months freezer; orzo will thicken, loosen with a measured splash of water or milk when reheating.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
